lines: Treasury yields surged above 5% intraday, pressuring Nasdaq and S&P 500 futures out of record territory and raising volatility risk into the open [56be7858a4].

Fed's Barr said further policy adjustments are likely as inflation risks rise, citing AI buildout, tariffs, and geopolitical shocks, with markets now pricing the next hike in October [748861a177][206520ce34][5d4c4e42eb][5c63735f4b][fe55efed7b][77cb565f4a].
Boston Fed's Collins separately warned inflation could stay notably above the 2% target after backing a rate hike, adding to the hawkish tone from Fed speakers [b2043794f7].
Stocks fell as rising oil prices and Treasury yields combined with inflation worries to weigh on sentiment [1948382f7c][e611e8657d].
A 5-Year note auction at 13:00 ET follows a session already dominated by yield-driven volatility, keeping rate-sensitive flows in focus [4df488921f][5f14ada1d3].
